about: Curated roles for a few of the design library's palettes (palettes/library.json): which of the library's own colours plays the dark anchor, the day accent (brand), the night accent (bright), the soft tint and the day paper, with a label and a line for the picker. Every other library palette gets its roles assigned by scripts/palettes.mjs. The last entry is the portal's own Bugambilia, with its tokens written out, the default.

dopely-gradient-05.label: Twilight
dopely-gradient-05.hint: Sunset orange and coral on twilight navy; warm white by day

dopely-winter-08.label: Marquee
dopely-winter-08.hint: Antique gold on a deep navy night; soft ivory by day

dopely-retro-06.label: Motel
dopely-retro-06.hint: Motel clay and sunbaked orange, roadside black; desert cream by day

dopely-desert-luxury-combo.label: Desert
dopely-desert-luxury-combo.hint: Terracotta on deep walnut; desert sand and warm cream by day

dopely-food-brand-05.label: Nori
dopely-food-brand-05.hint: Tuna red on nori black; rice white and ice blue by day

dopely-gradient-04.label: Dusk
dopely-gradient-04.hint: Lavender on dusk purple; bright purple on violet white by day

dopely-gradient-03.label: Aqua
dopely-gradient-03.hint: Soft mint on deep aqua; flow teal on frost white by day

dyslove-royal-blue-nitro-orange.label: Nitro
dyslove-royal-blue-nitro-orange.hint: Nitro orange on royal blue, the dark and bright pair; white by day

own.label: Bugambilia
own.hint: The portal's own palette, the default
